message:
The yen receipt test passes now. The full suite is green (3/3), and the receipt reads "Paid ¥500 by card".

The bug was in `src/utils/money.js`. `formatMoney` divided every amount by 100 and printed two decimals, so ¥500 (where the minor unit is one yen) showed as "¥5.00". I added a per-currency decimal table, `DECIMALS = { JPY: 0 }`, and any currency not listed still defaults to 2 decimals. The change also applies to invoices, since they share this function. Yen invoices will now show whole yen too.

I haven't committed anything. The only change is in `src/utils/money.js`.
